import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load data
gas_crime = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/bivariate/bivariate_2023_gas_crime.csv', index_col='borough')
adj = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv')

# Filter adjacency to known boroughs
valid = set(gas_crime.index)
adj = adj[adj['borough'].isin(valid) & adj['neighbor'].isin(valid)]

# Build symmetric adjacency dict
neighbors = {b: set() for b in valid}
for _, row in adj.iterrows():
    i, j = row['borough'], row['neighbor']
    neighbors[i].add(j)
    neighbors[j].add(i)

# Prepare borough list (only those with at least one neighbor)
boro_list = sorted([b for b, nbrs in neighbors.items() if len(nbrs)>0])
n = len(boro_list)

# Arrays of Gas and Crime values aligned to boro_list
gas_vals = np.array([gas_crime.loc[b, 'Gas_value'] for b in boro_list])
crime_vals = np.array([gas_crime.loc[b, 'Crime_value'] for b in boro_list])

# Precompute neighbor index lists
nbr_indices = []
for b in boro_list:
    nbr_indices.append([boro_list.index(nb) for nb in neighbors[b]])

# Compute neighbor mean crime for observed
neighbor_crime = np.array([crime_vals[idxs].mean() for idxs in nbr_indices])

# Compute observed Pearson correlation
obs_stat = np.corrcoef(gas_vals, neighbor_crime)[0,1]
print("Observed stat:", obs_stat)

Thought: Perform a permutation test with 1000 random shuffles of Crime_value to assess significance of the observed positive spatial cross-correlation.  
Action:
```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load and clean data
gas_crime = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/bivariate/bivariate_2023_gas_crime.csv', index_col='borough')
gas_crime = gas_crime.dropna(subset=['Gas_value', 'Crime_value'])
adj = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv')

# Filter adjacency
valid = set(gas_crime.index)
adj = adj[adj['borough'].isin(valid) & adj['neighbor'].isin(valid)]

# Build neighbor dict
neighbors = {b: set() for b in valid}
for _, r in adj.iterrows():
    i, j = r['borough'], r['neighbor']
    neighbors[i].add(j)
    neighbors[j].add(i)

# List of boroughs with neighbors
boro_list = sorted([b for b, nbrs in neighbors.items() if nbrs])
gas_vals = np.array([gas_crime.loc[b, 'Gas_value'] for b in boro_list])
crime_vals = np.array([gas_crime.loc[b, 'Crime_value'] for b in boro_list])

# Precompute neighbor index lists
nbr_indices = [[boro_list.index(nb) for nb in neighbors[b]] for b in boro_list]

# Observed statistic
neighbor_crime = np.array([crime_vals[idxs].mean() for idxs in nbr_indices])
obs_stat = np.corrcoef(gas_vals, neighbor_crime)[0,1]

# Permutation test
np.random.seed(0)
n_perm = 1000
perm_stats = np.zeros(n_perm)
for i in range(n_perm):
    perm_crime = np.random.permutation(crime_vals)
    perm_neighbor = np.array([perm_crime[idxs].mean() for idxs in nbr_indices])
    perm_stats[i] = np.corrcoef(gas_vals, perm_neighbor)[0,1]

# p-value for positive association
p_val = (np.sum(perm_stats >= obs_stat) + 1) / (n_perm + 1)
print("Observed stat:", obs_stat)
print("p-value:", p_val)
```
